Meta.title: Not My Inventory
Meta.author: jajohn7m
Meta.description:
Everything you carry stays yours. Grants the innate passive "Inventory Ward" (Feats tab), and the message log tells you whenever it saves you.
- Theft: gnomes, thieves and other steal abilities (items, food, gold), pickpockets, rogues skimming gold when you swap places, and bandits demanding an item all come away empty-handed. - Fire and cold can no longer burn, shatter or cook anything in your inventory (including inside containers), and your fireproof/coldproof blankets are no longer used up. - Acid can no longer corrode your equipment, and hostile curses can no longer curse or doom it.
Every protection, and the passive's name, can be toggled in BepInEx/config/jajohn7m.notmyinventory.cfg. Safe to remove: the game simply drops the passive from your save.
Source code: https://github.com/jajohn7m-source/NotMyInventory Made by jajohn7m
